description:
For years, the smartphone market has been dominated by Apple and Samsung—but Google’s Pixel lineup is slowly starting to gain ground.

After a decade of iteration, Pixel devices are becoming more refined, with improved hardware, longer software support, and deeper AI integration through Gemini. It’s not a dramatic shift, but steady progress is putting Google more firmly into the conversation.

The gap is still there—but it’s getting smaller.
